reason: This passage from Exodus 1:15-22 contains no mention of priests whatsoever. The text narrates the Pharaoh's command to Hebrew midwives regarding the birth of Hebrew children and their subsequent response. The passage focuses on the absolute authority of the Pharaoh (the political/royal authority) and the actions of midwives—not priests. There is no discussion of societal hierarchy that would establish priests as 'the most important group.' If anything, the passage demonstrates the supreme power of the Pharaoh over all others in Egyptian society.
